quote: This analysis included only subjects who answered at least one of the three CRT question correctly (92 of 150)
reason: The target effect is Experiment 1's primary context-based manipulation comparing composite moral acceptability ratings between the CRT-First and Dilemmas-First conditions after excluding participants who answered zero CRT items correctly (N = 92, t(90) = 2.03, d = 0.43, converted to r in Cova et al., 2018). The blind extraction mistakenly targeted a secondary correlation (r = .39) within the pre-exclusion CRT-First condition (n = 65).
